description: Update page-level layout: inheritance, overrides, or replace all layout blocks. Only call after the user confirms. If the result includes blockWarnings, the saved content violates the workspace block manifest (unknown field, wrong value shape, or a stored block whose type is no longer registered) - correct the content and save again, unless the warning is about a stored block whose type is no longer registered: that one is a manifest problem, so restore or sync the type, or find the block with list_block_usage and migrate or remove it. A block whose type the workspace block manifest does not register is refused unless the page already stores that block - pick registered types from list_block_types.

inheritsLayout.description: Whether this page inherits layout from its parent

layoutBlocks.description: Full replacement array of layout blocks (each must have 'type')

name: update_page_layout
